Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 34, "heading": "IV\nAΝΑΓΚΗ", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u034-b0086", "target": "— И потом, — продолжал проницательный Клод, — что это за приданое, которое должно стоить три флорина? И для ребёнка одриетки! С каких пор у вдов-одриеток бывают младенцы в пелёнках?", "source_sha256": "de914b2c6d035573a5bbc7df95464cdb125d64a69f17837b880d4a851f687f92", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u034-b0086", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "68d2aa9fb415bb0aefa36311231c21e5601b3f1200644f9652be7d8ee1543f09"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u034-b0087", "target": "Жеан в очередной раз сломал лёд. — Ну да! Мне нужны деньги, чтобы нынче вечером навестить Изабо ла Тьерри в Валь-д'Амур!", "source_sha256": "c6dc7ca01f8e8b6aadbf3471e7b044e7f30a57ce984706dbe8a3eb2b55014628", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u034-b0087", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "25de2822a752afd42010d045921437c1dc367ee4e9fa51d57b280e2a232eee4c"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 7, "chapter": 4, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u034-b0088", "text": "—Misérable impur! s'écria le prêtre.", "sha256": "800c1ead51ef6a6090e2d593790e6fee2fc659317aca10dd9de16faafb3629b6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1916], "source_xml_sha256": "0d41f8f64cc1793e862df99bf881a4de5d8be979a0ff4c2df0f65090f7c879bb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0089", "text": "—»Aναγνεία, dit Jehan.", "sha256": "e0c580889896c817175e257aac2659c4b0fae1b08c4a8845c77b51d00eeb1f62", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1917], "source_xml_sha256": "a59a3079b8fc132a5f3e2a7602b35f0a4e631fabaeede2d47e960cb2113e0e8f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0090", "text": "Cette citation, que l'écolier empruntait, peut-être avec malice, à la muraille de la cellule, fit sur le prêtre un effet singulier. Il se mordit les lèvres, et sa colère s'éteignit dans la rougeur.", "sha256": "d27b9c7c70b7fc51389777f8b601d9c880de8e331e5d99c02619cc0ce761a3f0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1918], "source_xml_sha256": "260ddb3267a5cd227fe69c60b0ff6e10a06f745431cb261f5158ee6fcea2f184", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0091", "text": "«Allez-vous-en, dit-il alors à Jehan. J'attends quelqu'un.»", "sha256": "7d7f7e9ea8ffe6afa2a1d570de50ccaf415b51f4548a59a872410660f10a1ef9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1919], "source_xml_sha256": "25666863d93164b046bdb1576c7f6af9a2f90ae09629fd7f848e2fa2b7bd1823", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0092", "text": "L'écolier tenta encore un effort.", "sha256": "48b01f711a3a10f81cf97c4236c2fc1bab54930c9b16e3e136e15be13fb2b669", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1920], "source_xml_sha256": "66917fedd61fe5952541f8d624396021eed4a30f77a4690d5999229f5695e74c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0093", "text": "«Frère Claude, donnez-moi au moins un petit parisis pour manger.", "sha256": "64f163d0e3c9ec40e7da2c7c444fa8ebe3baf5acd585881e374078d1bc263911", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1921], "source_xml_sha256": "256f6c09eb53b80fc224e655fbdfb82c8a94f428223144fdb922879356b2122d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0094", "text": "—Où en êtes-vous des décrétales de Gratien? demanda dom Claude.", "sha256": "b403a42951344ae95c14ea30c5b74cde0bfa527b9cd13392c60060bc3f80ae45", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1922], "source_xml_sha256": "ff45e06f47a9c64e39bcb2974a90ec8d531f9f32c3573a76255d3ec4733c39df", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0095", "text": "—J'ai perdu mes cahiers.", "sha256": "05b4f185fde1cbd1c95791963f600519cf451061ad66140891f238adb46e5955", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1923], "source_xml_sha256": "9cf86d33eba3228b5d7e586efcb8f2dc338428cec5730757e3d8846b0a4391ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0096", "text": "—Où en êtes-vous des humanités latines?", "sha256": "d8db39966eaec638b3af2cc77ec0a85e11043233a938199b20b17bddee228db5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1924], "source_xml_sha256": "f2ed22c23563c8fcf2ce1a36e01d321f4b32342e1fb26b6de6096329f0f13e39", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0097", "text": "—On m'a volé mon exemplaire d'Horatius.", "sha256": "37b3f6c45d9a74b9c5e032b06d64b69ce353ea56bb5d3151ef4f386359bb5533", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1925], "source_xml_sha256": "2674bd48ab362a95c8474544e43c4f549615577f9bce9e82a782abd33590f8de", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0098", "text": "—Où en êtes-vous d'Aristoteles?", "sha256": "d67aeacec26cc458d69202aa22a51864e62bcff03229b7ccce993247ba2be2ff", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1926], "source_xml_sha256": "abab30fae0d7c04946f64a8fb86e8644bb4b17879c5180b2b15424614684f256", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0099", "text": "—Ma foi! frère, quel est donc ce père de l'église qui dit que les erreurs des hérétiques ont de tout temps eu pour repaire les broussailles de la métaphysique d'Aristoteles? Foin d'Aristoteles! je ne veux pas déchirer ma religion à sa métaphysique.", "sha256": "f82777c44a7db31176996e6fb0ae16c2bf7da01e6649c7a5fdfd406dc79fbaab", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1927], "source_xml_sha256": "6221f64dabb2c687e5c938ce9d0723c60e78d10da72534495c25e2b2c66e0f83", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0100", "text": "—Jeune homme, reprit l'archidiacre, il y avait à la dernière entrée du roi un gentilhomme appelé Philippe de Comines, qui portait brodée sur la houssure de son cheval sa devise, que je vous conseille de méditer: [[I]]Qui non laborat non manducet[[/I]][[N94]].»", "sha256": "ba8fa87a2f54dbfecf73b9bdf55d28b4e7e0025ca41249f483c3a9b823dc3880", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1928], "source_xml_sha256": "35baa8344d6005d4d6c49df11e2d41663ec6a8dfe87510bb01ff3c89e327460d", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N94]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0101", "text": "L'écolier resta un moment silencieux, le doigt à l'oreille, l'œil fixé à terre, et la mine fâchée. Tout à coup il se retourna vers Claude avec la vive prestesse d'un hoche-queue.", "sha256": "222667014f0238215c32a8bdd6198d2a8b60aead2ed6bde8eb0b3b90ba0ae7c1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1929], "source_xml_sha256": "cb9bf931f05ea853b6b606dd1b3a94f6caffc23255e6fc546f28d5b5f5b42d05", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0102", "text": "«Ainsi, bon frère, vous me refusez un sou parisis pour acheter une croûte chez un talmellier?", "sha256": "999963f9b5db47cf1efe6e8f424c8434a39bb8dd50919e71c4c9b639c382c5b6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1930], "source_xml_sha256": "c8cddb80d8d4fc47d8d1e7a25d881804e9ab8ed1df1c75af4d6de12053d70f54", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0103", "text": "—[[I]]Qui non laborat non manducet.[[/I]]", "sha256": "851ecf3c809ec5c4c0b13ac136dbea72a5a61da5e9531afcea2e3b6145ad0742", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1931], "source_xml_sha256": "a390e59d6ebffe26c583f55d86d55c0379e110c78753f1c30630aa8e06501c72", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0104", "text": "À cette réponse de l'inflexible archidiacre, Jehan cacha sa tête dans ses mains, comme une femme qui sanglote, et s'écria avec une expression de désespoir: Ὀτοτοτοτοτοῖ[[N95]]!", "sha256": "ff66740173a45a9628b37e738367034ae741b0012b748c94fe3e515f9fa59395", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1932], "source_xml_sha256": "95a31641511091c9d42130fecd27ce3c35d309d89287e61fb69e3828246406e3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N95]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0105", "text": "«Qu'est-ce que cela veut dire, monsieur? demanda Claude surpris de cette incartade.", "sha256": "9764909c7b1b3611eda10aa370ce497406d6eee79f007cffcbe730e461fa06ed", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1933], "source_xml_sha256": "d3288000491dfcd919cdeead33ea69122830429f455974d09d5cac35dcbffada", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0106", "text": "—Eh bien quoi! dit l'écolier, et il relevait sur Claude des yeux effrontés dans lesquels il venait d'enfoncer ses poings pour leur donner la rougeur des larmes, c'est du grec! c'est un anapeste d'Eschyles qui exprime parfaitement la douleur.»", "sha256": "312bd59fde50c27681083c6517db0f6ddda6255bdb369ba23045556cefd68d1e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1934], "source_xml_sha256": "5828c44223aa4ad8434217852e8697c5231c2463d19f2ae13caad73681a9d2fb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0107", "text": "Et ici, il partit d'un éclat de rire si bouffon et si violent qu'il en fit sourire l'archidiacre. C'était la faute de Claude en effet! pourquoi avait-il tant gâté cet enfant?", "sha256": "cfb4b2ba04c2f868a8f6921b0ba222b65018282a1c9773f59d38a694e7cf00b6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1935], "source_xml_sha256": "0427256d58941a4c6c8479b8517782724dc21252050b681c8de0e0623e8b39d1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0108", "text": "«Oh! bon frère Claude, reprit Jehan enhardi par ce sourire, voyez mes brodequins percés. Y a-t-il cothurne plus tragique au monde que des bottines dont la semelle tire la langue?»", "sha256": "ad6ec9c67f823502cbf4a23afc6c054656192cea327683aadad6dfc302ec64cc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1936], "source_xml_sha256": "594359a2c380a2ce5cf0db2400a209b3f64aae51c97ec9e66e1a7ba0a0cac229", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0109", "text": "L'archidiacre était promptement revenu à sa sévérité première. «Je vous enverrai des bottines neuves. Mais point d'argent.", "sha256": "93aa973468ae498479efa4082972cc5c263df48063f2c06ad11b481275110beb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1937], "source_xml_sha256": "9bf7058e1087eeaceff98d1d439f92836b729bcb0e3125078981e75f39a3453c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0110", "text": "—Rien qu'un pauvre petit parisis, frère, poursuivit le suppliant Jehan. J'apprendrai Gratien par cœur, je croirai bien en Dieu, je serai un véritable Pythagoras de science et de vertu. Mais un petit parisis, par grâce! Voulez-vous que la famine me morde avec sa gueule qui est là, béante, devant moi, plus noire, plus puante, plus profonde qu'un tartare ou que le nez d'un moine?»", "sha256": "ad4152bfabe97b291d4c16ac3f2754c52ec2b00211fb404ef88974ddb70c9f77", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1938], "source_xml_sha256": "b901cbee061296eda5cef5290aa35c1f8e25218e53a59346f432eea346909846", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0111", "text": "Dom Claude hocha son chef ridé. «[[I]]Qui non laborat...[[/I]]»", "sha256": "640a8c30decee7b2274f03ec1ebb627980ba5eecb446c30aa42a0814e834c9f0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1939], "source_xml_sha256": "061e20ee769bc87a0070b8c99502d6ebdc4dfe11a55a1bb93b84737eed5c7c86", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0112", "text": "Jehan ne le laissa pas achever.", "sha256": "c9d8e6baad1a8596e0781c6c74d84821c9ab6882ee09f3e8d561a42597c7a6ef", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1940], "source_xml_sha256": "580d1b51800b8cb3fc0a949702ea56442554de059f5ae7d36352a75729843fa7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0113", "text": "«Eh bien, cria-t-il, au diable! Vive la joie! Je m'entavernerai, je me battrai, je casserai les pots et j'irai voir les filles!»", "sha256": "d55b236083376c443e7b3fcd0505eacdaf3c574eb5ee4ec94d3f3fc9d2c0c5f5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1941], "source_xml_sha256": "59a21b226857cb8c760dcc1c3aad58e593ff92846172dff6be4d8e471f8bb16a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0114", "text": "Et sur ce, il jeta son bonnet au mur et fit claquer ses doigts comme des castagnettes.", "sha256": "fffb8c9c18625720ac4371cfbba4d4bebc0017eeeb5a9acc8e6ddcb1da7632f3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1942], "source_xml_sha256": "fb7a6fcc08448079b1d69d0d59a9e69763fea827eb9c073848dbebe25617735d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0115", "text": "L'archidiacre le regarda d'un air sombre.", "sha256": "00c1f3a3dbb4dcbe53ef193617f8223e8b75fffd7a3aa63c10eee5b3d510e8bd", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1943], "source_xml_sha256": "f1bdde9b3e284bac3830b68f978f468863f74ac2548fe0ef8d826b9c464e188c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0116", "text": "«Jehan, vous n'avez point d'âme.", "sha256": "7683aec1928b971a5cdad8221cb5dbbb0960e7fe210b0ed9231e8938516d3a8f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1944], "source_xml_sha256": "eba225232551a796525d6e0340b397f3931288c1835b8ea7d162e7bfebdc4ce3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0117", "text": "—En ce cas, selon Epicurius, je manque d'un je ne sais quoi fait de quelque chose qui n'a pas de nom.", "sha256": "5cdfc782f17ae28c28ea319abc6676c5fa65308ec3801a830bfb639e61e7582b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1945], "source_xml_sha256": "5ffcb0da352ef123819d7e848e5a1cb3ac22f567121e59903c38042c86a3fb11", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0118", "text": "—Jehan, il faut songer sérieusement à vous corriger.", "sha256": "1de8638615537d2832f6b3cb9b2f5f64cc91ae19596d34500e42073ff45fae26", "role":
